description: This Dart source file defines the AuthService class, which manages authentication operations such as login, token persistence, and user retrieval in a frontend application. It interacts with an external API client and handles persistent storage via shared preferences and local cache.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: A service class that handles user authentication, token storage, and user session management.

methods.name: AuthService
methods.description: Constructor initializing the AuthService with an API client.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Retrieves the stored authentication token from shared preferences or local cache.

methods.name: setToken
methods.description: Stores or removes the authentication token in shared preferences, local cache, and updates the API client token.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login via API, stores the received access token, and returns it.

methods.name: me
methods.description: Fetches the current user's data from the API and returns a User object.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears the stored token, effectively logging out the user.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Initializes the AuthService, restoring token if available, for app startup.
